title: UI Design Fundamentals
learning_objectives: Master advanced UI design principles in PEGA
Learn to create intuitive and efficient user interfaces
Understand accessibility and usability best practices

introduction.title: Advanced UI Design in PEGA
introduction.text: Building on the basics of PEGA UI components, this tutorial explores advanced design principles and best practices for creating exceptional user experiences. You'll learn how to design interfaces that are not only functional but also intuitive, accessible, and efficient for your users.

sections.title: UI Design Principles
sections.content: Effective UI design follows established principles that ensure usability and user satisfaction.

principles.description: Keep interfaces clean and focused on the user's primary tasks
Maintain consistent patterns throughout your application
Design with your users' needs and workflows in mind

sections.title: Form Design Best Practices
sections.content: Forms are central to most PEGA applications. Well-designed forms improve user efficiency and reduce errors.

best_practices.description: Organize fields in a logical, task-oriented sequence
tips: Follow natural reading patterns (top to bottom, left to right)
Use progressive disclosure for complex forms

best_practices.description: Provide clear, helpful labels and instructions
tips: Indicate required vs. optional fields clearly

best_practices.description: Choose the right input control for each type of data

sections.title: Responsive Design Implementation
sections.content: Ensure your PEGA applications work well across all devices and screen sizes.

responsive_techniques.description: Adjust content presentation based on device capabilities

sections.title: Accessibility Guidelines
sections.content: Design inclusive interfaces that work for users with diverse abilities and needs.

practices: Don't rely solely on color to convey information
Use readable fonts and appropriate sizes
Ensure all interactive elements are keyboard accessible

summary.title: Key Takeaways
points: Good UI design follows established principles of clarity, consistency, and user-centered design
Forms should be logically organized with clear labels and appropriate controls
Responsive design ensures applications work across all devices
Accessibility is essential for inclusive user experiences
Regular testing and user feedback drive continuous improvement
